spec.problem: Admin Dictionary reuses the shared OperationsResourceClient for canonical lexeme management; the live page, filters, detail/examples, mutations, RBAC and audit behavior have not yet been verified against the local runtime.

acceptance.text: The Admin Dictionary route renders through a real authorized browser session; anonymous and insufficient-role behavior is verified in the UI and backend.

List, search, JLPT and reading filters, pagination, details/examples, create/edit/review/publish/archive, validation, persistence and audit behavior are exercised against the local API where supported.

Every active METHOD+PATH used by the screen receives an individual status/contract and appropriate unauthorized/invalid-input check; locally reproducible defects are fixed with regression coverage and retested in the visible browser.

spec.expected_behavior: Dictionary presents canonical lexemes and routes management actions through authenticated, permission-checked Go APIs with durable changes and audit evidence.
spec.observed_behavior: The route delegates to OperationsResourceClient and requests /api/admin/content?type=lexeme, but the visible screen/API contract and mutation paths have not yet been tested in the current runtime.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert only Dictionary-specific client/backend/test changes; preserve unrelated staged changes and audit checkpoints.
